speech._clientsNote: Language layer (B-18/X-05, docs/agent/LANGUAGE_LAYER.md). REST clients by id; every one ships DISABLED with ${PLACEHOLDER} endpoints and keys that resolve from local.properties SPEECH_* entries (never committed). To turn one on: put its SPEECH_* values in local.properties, set enabled=true, then list its id under providers.speech.asr.online.<lang> / tts.<role> (models.json) or mt.<direction> (below). A client that is disabled, missing a key or not https is never built, so routing falls through to the on-device engines.

hcilab_asr._note: UG HCI Lab Speech Gateway, Akan/Twi recogniser (docs: https://lab-subscription-platform.vercel.app/dashboard/documentation). POST multipart `file` (wav, ≤120 s, ≤10 MB) with a Bearer token → a transcript. The gateway URL is public; the TOKEN goes in local.properties as SPEECH_HCILAB_TOKEN=speech_live_… (never committed) — without it this client isn't built. Free plan (2026-09-28): 5/min, 10/day, 50/week, 30 min audio/week — counted on the phone (QuotaLedger), so a spent quota falls straight through to the on-device recogniser. Routed for Twi only (models.json asr.online.twi).

response._pathNote: The docs don't show the ASR reply body yet: the first of these that holds text is used.

hcilab_tts._note: UG HCI Lab Speech Gateway, Twi voice. POST JSON {text, model_type:"ss", speaker:"PT"} (≤250 characters) → audio/wav (errors come back as JSON — never played). Token as for hcilab_asr. Free plan: 5/min, 15/day, 70/week, 5,000 characters/week, counted on the phone. A reply longer than one request (maxParts) is left to the phone's voice so the day's requests go to the short Twi lines (confirmations, questions) that matter most; those are cached in memory.

hcilab_mt._note: The HCI Lab gateway offers ASR and TTS only (2026-09-28 docs) — no translation. Kept as a disabled shape for a future MT API.

space_mt._note: OUR language Space (PrinceAlhassanNasamu/tekyerema-lang, ZeroGPU Gradio) serving the owner's own NLLB fine-tune tekyerema-nllb600m-v1 — translation switched on there 2 October 2026 (it had shipped with TK_MT=0, so every request came back untranslated). Gradio's two-step API (dialect 'gradio', api 'translate', data [text, src, tgt]); a '"covered": false' answer counts as no translation. Off unless local.properties has SPEECH_SPACE_URL=https://princealhassannasamu-tekyerema-lang.hf.space (public; no key). ~2.7 s a call warm, ~11 s on a cold model.

nllb_mt._note: Our own free translator: Meta's NLLB-200 on a Hugging Face Space (services/nllb-space; owner's pick, 2 October 2026 — Google needs billing). POST {text, source, target} with a Bearer token → {translation}. local.properties: SPEECH_NLLB_URL=https://<space>.hf.space/translate and SPEECH_NLLB_TOKEN=… (the Space's API_TOKEN secret; never committed). A free Space sleeps after ~2 days idle: the first call after that waits for it to wake (callMs).

google_mt._note: Google Cloud Translation v2 — Twi is the code 'ak'. Owner's pick, 2 October 2026 (translation was missing since the Khaya removal of 27 September). The key goes in local.properties as SPEECH_GOOGLE_TRANSLATE_KEY=… (never committed; restrict it to the Cloud Translation API) — without it this client isn't built. Sent in the X-goog-api-key header, never in the URL.

khaya_mt._note: GhanaNLP Khaya translation (what Tɛkyerɛma used until 27 September) — the fallback after Google. POST {in, lang:'tw-en'|'en-tw'} → a bare JSON string. Key in local.properties as SPEECH_KHAYA_KEY=… (never committed). Its free quota was spent until about 17 October 2026; a quota error rests it until then.

khaya_web_mt._note: Khaya web platform (the owner's new key, 15 Oct 2026) — translation. POST {in, lang:'eng-twi'|'twi-eng'} → a bare JSON string, ~0.6 s (the Space took 3–8 s). Key in local.properties as SPEECH_KHAYA_WEB_KEY=… (never committed). A per-minute rate limit applies (429 RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED after ~12 quick calls).

khaya_web_asr._note: Khaya web platform — Twi speech recognition. POST raw audio/wav to /asr/v1/transcribe?language=twi → {text, warnings}, ~1.7 s. Owner, 16 Oct 2026: routed as the BACKUP behind hcilab_asr (models.json asr.online.twi) — the hackathon asks for the UG HCI Lab, so the lab stays first.

space_asr._note: OUR OWN Twi hearing model (tekyerema-asr-ctc-twi-v2, a w2v-BERT CTC fine-tune; 18 Oct 2026) served by the language Space — the backup behind hcilab_asr, which has 10 requests a day. Gradio two-step API asr_b64 (base64 WAV + language -> text). ~2 s warm, ~28 s on a cold model.

space_tts._note: OUR OWN Twi voice (tekyerema-tts-twi) on the language Space — the backup behind hcilab_tts, whose new lines take 20-90+ s (18 Oct 2026). Gradio two-step API tts (text + language -> a WAV file to download), 1-2 s. Twi only.

space_asr_kus._note: 19 Oct 2026 (owner: Kusaal selectable, 'it will use the online spaces'): OUR Kusaal hearing model on the language Space (asr_b64 with language 'kus'). Its own quota group, so a Kusaal failure never rests the Twi backup. Kusaal is never sent to the HCI Lab (no Kusaal there).

space_tts_kus._note: 19 Oct 2026: OUR Kusaal voice (tekyerema-tts-kus v3) on the language Space (api tts, language 'kus'; the Space reads numbers in Kusaal words). Behind it, the same voice on the phone (kusvoice).

space_mt_kus._note: 19 Oct 2026: Kusaal <-> English through the language Space's translator (tekyerema-nllb600m-v3: Kusaal chrF++ up ~5 over v2). Its own quota group (the Twi translator's breaker is untouched).

space_tts_eng._note: 19 Oct 2026 (owner: 'Is it possible you add his voice?'): ENGLISH replies in Kafui Dey's voice — the language Space's English is ONLY the F5 Kafui voice (an error, never another voice, when its ZeroGPU fails). Used through providers.speech.tts.ghEnglish: RoutingTts fetches sentence by sentence, the first within speech.ghEnglish.firstWaitMs (6 s), and the English chain (own on-device voice, the phone's engine) speaks when it is off, resting, slow or failing. speech.ghEnglish.enabled=false turns it off at once.

khaya_web_tts._note: Khaya web platform — Twi voice. POST {text, language:'twi'} to /tts/v1/synthesize → audio/wav, ~1.3 s. Owner, 16 Oct 2026: the backup behind hcilab_tts (models.json tts.twi).

openai_asr._note: Any OpenAI-compatible /audio/transcriptions server, e.g. a hosted Ghanaian-English Whisper tune. Ghanaian English ONLY (Whisper has no Twi token) — list it under asr.online.gh_en, never twi or auto. Reuses the existing local.properties slots ASR_ONLINE_URL (…/v1), ASR_ONLINE_KEY, ASR_ONLINE_MODEL.

mt._note: Translator ids per direction, tried in order (a client without its key isn't built and is skipped). enToTwi localizes English replies for a Twi speaker (ReplyLocalizer: never text with numbers/money, names must survive, else the original is spoken). twiToEn puts a Twi request into English for the cloud planner, which gets BOTH (VoiceEngine.goalInEnglish → RoutingBrain.cloudGoalFor).
mt._waitsNote: 20 Oct 2026 (reliability audit): every Twi translation wait capped so a reply is never 38-53 s of silence; rehearsed lines come from MtDiskCache at once.

language._note: B-05 LanguageSession: replies follow the language of the user's last turn while the conversation is live (conversationTtlSec); the persisted habitual language (the low-signal fallback after a pause) changes only after habitualSwitchTurns turns in a row in the other language.

asr._offlineTwiNote: ON again 20 Oct 2026 (owner: the full Space model on the phone, like English): w2vbert_ctc (tekyerema-asr-ctc-twi-v2 int8 ONNX) in files/ondevice/twi/asr, used when Twi online hearing is unreachable or fails. Earlier: Offline Twi hearing (the on-device omni CTC model) is OFF — owner, 3 October 2026: online Twi first, English-only offline for now. true = an on-device Twi model with its own model.json is used when the HCI Lab can't be reached. Findings and the plan: docs/agent/OFFLINE_TWI.md.
asr._loadPeakNote: 21 Oct 2026: the 4-bit full Twi model (q4b64c8, 384 MB) measured 438 MB anonymous RSS after load with no arena and no prepacking (ORT 1.17.1, Kaggle) — 1.2x its file, not the 1.5x default.
